name: design-systems
author: c-wenlong
login: No sign-in — the tailnet is the only boundary.
description: The private designs repo as a browsable library: the gallery of every captured design system (tokens, screenshots, components) plus the docs site and scorecard. nginx listens on 127.0.0.1:8108 behind Serve and proxies the Next.js gallery app (designs-web.service, 127.0.0.1:8191) for /gallery/ and the API, and proxies /systems/, /tools/, /catalog.json and /README.md through the app's /media/ route, which reads the working clone at ~/dev/design-systems live (it refuses gitignored files, dot paths and symlink escapes; the ~300 MB of LFS screenshots are never copied into a release). /example/ is not served. No passphrase: the repo's own Pages deploy strips and encrypts the gallery, but the tailnet is the boundary here. deployd rebuilds when the clone's HEAD moves; ~/services/design-systems/bin/deploy.sh --force rebuilds now.
